thread:
kai: Quick pulse check after the all-hands   few logistics items about hybrid, offsite travel, and SF facilities. Dropping the short answers here.

maya: Thanks Kai. Short bullets: hoteling rules, guest policy, expense flow, and a note on family accommodations.

emily: Are we still doing first-come hoteling for SF commons desks? Team ran into locked door yesterday.

maya: Commons desks are first-come but need daily check-in on the kiosk before 9am to avoid hold-release. If your team needs guaranteed space, request a recurring block via facilities@redwood.com.

raj: Can people bring a partner to the offsite welcome reception? Would travel be covered?

leah: One guest per attendee is allowed for social events only. Company covers the reception ticket; guests' travel and lodging are on the employee unless the manager approves otherwise. If it's for family-inclusive programming, submit an exception in the offsite form.

kai: What's the policy for childcare/dependents at offsite? A few folks asked about bringing young kids.

leah: We don't cover childcare costs by default. Managers can request family accommodations (on-site childcare or stipends) for special circumstances; approvals are handled on a case-by-case basis and need 3 weeks lead time. Tag me in the request.

emily: Expense system confusion for contractors again  Concur vs Expensely? Plus any new receipt rules?

maya: Expensely is primary for everyone now. Contractors: use Expensely unless contract says otherwise and mark "Contractor" in the submission. Receipts required for items >$25; mobile uploads accepted.

ops-bot: Reminder: offsite headcount + dietary form closes 2026-07-18 23:59 UTC. Link in the all-hands doc.

raj: Visa support for APAC attendees  process/time?

leah: Facilities will submit visa docs and cover standard fees for attendees included on the official list. Send passport scan + travel dates to me by 2026-07-04. We'll cover standard processing and expedited fees when approved.

kai: Any changes to per-diem? I heard a city-rate variant might be used for a couple of expensive cities.

maya: Base per-diem remains $60/day. For high-cost-event cities request a city-rate adjustment via the offsite form; Finance reviews exceptions (typical turnaround 3 business days).

emily: Lockers/phone rooms in SF  pilot status?

maya: Locker pilot on 2nd floor. Phone booths are QR-book only; details on WorkplaceBook. Facilities will post a short signup link.

raj: Cancellation/no-show fees  what to do if flights change?

leah: Submit a cancellation appeal to facilities@redwood.com within 48 hours with proof (e.g. airline notification) and we'll waive fees for verified travel disruptions.

kai: Follow-ups/action items: Leah -> publish family-accommodation guidance and visa checklist; Maya -> update the all-hands note with kiosk check-in rules and locker link; Facilities -> confirm recurring block process. I'll repost links once they're live.

maya: Thanks everyone  please DM if you need special handling. :thumbsup:

emily: Appreciate it  I'll share with my team.
